entries.notes: lu (m.sg.), la (f.sg.), li (m.pl.), le (f.pl.). After prepositions except de/te they double: cu llu tata, a lla nonna. North-western Lecce province uses li for both plurals.
Garrisi writes nnu/nna (also the numeral); many writers use nu/na. Do not confuse with the negation nu.
te and de alternate with phrase rhythm; te does NOT trigger doubling.
